guidebook.role.description.wathe:civilia:
The base civilian role. They have no unique features.

About Innocents:

 - Objective: Rid the train of all killers and accomplices.

Clue System & The Emergency Revolver:

 - Can search the train for clues. Obtaining enough clues will grant them an emergency revolver.

 - Emergency revolvers do not drop on death. Revolvers cannot be picked up if the innocent has an emergency revolver. They can use their emergency revolver to pick up the revolver, however.

Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.

They win with other civilians and vigilantes. They do not have to kill accomplices unless they have turned into a killer.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:vigilan:
The base vigilante role. They spawn with a revolver.

 - Has the same objectives as innocents (see Civilian for details).

Revolver Item:

 - The revolver drops upon the owner's untimely death. Unarmed innocents or the executioner can pick up the revolver.

 - Revolvers that drop off the train will appear back on the train after 60 seconds.

 - Innocents who shoots another innocent will cause the shooter to die of guilt. Shooting Accomplices, Killers, or the Executioner's target do not cause the shooter to die.
guidebook.role.description.wathe:killer:
The base killer role. They have no unique features.

About Killers:

 - Objective: Eliminate every non-killer cohort passengers on the %1$s by any means.

 - Killers cannot pick up dropped revolvers.

 - They win with other killers and killer accomplices.

Clue System:

 - Killers can search the train for clues.

 - Obtaining enough clues will grant them money.

Instinct Overhaul:

 - Killer instinct is limited and drains whenever instinct is used.

 - Instinct becomes less reliable as the color changes. The range you can see lowers with continuous use, and seeing innocent mood colors become restricted. There are 4 sections of the instinct bar: 

   1. Red (100-70%): Works like pre-nerfed instinct (infinite range). Can see up to depressive mood (Blue)

    2. Orange (70-40%): See players up to 80 blocks away. Can only see up to stressed mood (Light blue).

   3. Yellow (40-10%): See players up to 40 blocks away. Can only see up to content mood (Green)

   4. Grey (10-0%): Same as yellow. You cannot use instinct unless you go above the gray threshold. Instinct can still be drained into gray however, just not used from it.

 - You gain back instinct overtime and by doing tasks (adds 15%). You will always see accomplices and killers anywhere regardless of your instinct bar %.
guidebook.role.description.starexpress:m:
Has access to Tape which can silence players on the train.

Duct Tape Item:

 - Is invisible when held, and can be used by right-clicking on another passenger (Including killers & accomplices).

 - Taped passengers cannot speak, and must have another passenger remove the tape to gain back their voice. Innocents who remove tape from others lose mood for doing so.

Taped passengers will die if their mood drops to 0 and another passenger removes the tape.

 - Taped passengers will die if they are outside for 60 seconds.
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Has the ability to disguise themselves as another living passenger.

Ability:

 - Can disguise as a passenger by pressing their head in the inventory screen.

 - A disguise lasts for 45 seconds. Has a 30 second cooldown.

 - Morphlings can force their disguise to end using their ability key.

 - If the original passenger dies in any way, the disguise is removed from the morphling immediately.

Make sure to check if the person next to you is actually that person!

Has the ability to turn invisible.

Ability:

 - Turns invisible for 20 seconds. Has a 60 second cooldown.

 - This ability has 3 charges.

 - When invisible, held items and particles from sprinting can be seen by others.

 - Their footsteps, voice, and used items can also still be heard.

Has the ability to swap any player with any other player, teleporting both players to the other's location. This can include the swapper themself.

This role is disabled due to it's overpowered nature in-game. In the event of this role ever being enabled, then inform an operator of it's existence so it can be disabled again.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:the_in: The Insane Damned Paranoid Killer Of Doom Death Destruction And Waffles
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Can hear dead people.

 - This is mostly a joke killer role, and is normally disabled.

 - In the event of this being enabled, all it does is allow you to hear the dead.

This role is disabled by default. But is planned to be reworked in the future.

Check back after it is announced to see how they work!

Wants an innocent killed by non-killer methods to become a killer. Has an ability to switch targets.

 - Is given an innocent target who they want killed by non-killer means (Getting shot by another innocent or a non-killer assisted death). The target cannot be a vigilante.

 - The target is considered evil if the executioner is alive, meaning innocents who shoot the target will not die from guilt.

 - If the target is successfully killed, the Executioner is promoted to a random killer role.

 - If the target dies from killer means, then the target randomizes to another non-vigilante innocent.

 - The Executioner can shoot their target directly, but will be forced to drop the gun afterwards. Shooting a non-target will kill them and the Executioner.

Ability:

 - Randomizes their target to be another innocent. Can only be used once.

Accomplice Characteristics:

 - Can pick up a dropped revolver.

 - Cannot distinguish others as killers or other accomplices, but is shown as a Killer Cohort to those who can.

 - Does not have to be killed for innocents to win unless they are a killer.

Keep a look out for anyone who drops a gun after shooting another player. Only Executioners will do this!

If you shoot another player based-off suspicion alone, be sure to confirm your shot with a coroner, as there's a high chance you just made added another killer on the train.

Has the ability to consume bodies to become a killer.

Ability:

 - Consuming a body will briefly apply slowness with particles along with playing a sound cue.

 - Consumed bodies scrambles the time of death and role of the body.

 - Consuming enough bodies will promote the Vulture to a random killer role.

Accomplice Characteristics:

 - Cannot pick up a dropped revolver.

 - Cannot distinguish others as killers or other accomplices, but is shown as a Killer Cohort to those who can.

 - Does not have to be killed for innocents to win unless they are a killer.

Be mindful of any light blue particles and consumption sounds that emit from another passenger!

guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:conduc: It's not a Lockpick I Swear
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Has Master Keys which can unlock every door on the train.

 - Spawns with a Master Key which grants access to every locked door on the %1$s.

Master Keys Item:

 - Master Keys are dropped on death, which can be picked up by anyone, including killers.

 - If there are less than 10 passengers aboard the %1$s, the Master Keys appear as Lockpicks.

Only 1 innocent can be the Conductor.

Can see poisoned food/drink trays or beds and passengers who drink beverages. They can also buy drinks for themselves.

 - Poisoned food/drink trays or beds will emit pink clouds.

 - Any passenger who drink are glowed to the bartender for 10 seconds.

 - Can purchase standard drinks for 75 coins.

Only 1 innocent can be the Bartender.

Their body will glow upon being killed and can buy firecrackers.

 - Noisemakers gain 50 coins when completing a task and 5 coins passively.

 - Can purchase Firecrackers for 75 coins.

Has an ability to emergency teleport out of a sticky situation.

Ability:

 - Use the ability to set a location.

 - Use the ability again to teleport back to that location.

 - Teleporting only has one use and costs 200 coins. Use it wisely!

 - Recallers gain 50 coins when completing a task.

NOTE: When setting a location, avoid non-flat surfaces and wall hugging. There is a chance the teleport will fail otherwise.

Can read dead bodies.

 - Viewing a body will show the time of death and role of a passenger body. They must be above 50% sanity to view bodies.

 - Vulture consumed bodies will show scrambled text on the body.

 - They are the only innocent who can confirm the presence of vulture consumption on a corpse.

Makes you short.

 - Yeah, you're short now. Deal with it.

Only 1 player can be short.

Standing still will turn them invisible at a slow rate.

 - Moving or being collided with causes them to appear visible again.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:guesse: Hey Guys my Role is Death By Voodoo Magic
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Gains the ability to guess the role of any innocent player.

Ability:

 - Adds passenger heads to the inventory screen. These heads can be pressed to open up a menu to type in their role.

 - Correctly guessing causes the victim to die immediately.

 - Guessing incorrectly causes the guesser to die.

This modifier is only assigned to killers.

Can see information about dead bodies like the Coroner does. Can also see their modifier.

 - This modifier is only assigned to killers.
guidebook.role.title.noellesroles:feathe: Nuh uh Can't Body Block Me
guidebook.role.description.noellesroles::
Is unable to collide with other players. Additionally has slow falling.

 - Can fall off the side of the train with time to save themselves.

Can gain additional coins by being near other players up to 5 blocks away.

 - Up to 20 additional coins (4 players) can be gained every time coins are given passively.

 - Cannot gain coins from other killers or neutral evils.

This modifier is only assigned to killers.

Can see items up to 8 blocks away including through walls.

 - Items seen have an orange glow.

This modifier is only assigned to innocents. Vigilantes and Bartenders cannot have sixth sense. Only 1 innocent can have sixth sense.
